description: Draft quote lines from a visit, in the worker's words and what you saw and heard. You set the price: read comparables and pricing_rules on the result (or call quotes.comparables), apply the shop's rules, and pass unit_price_minor or total_minor plus basis, a short note of how you got the price. That note is stored and read to the owner. Leave the price out and Doing Work fills a default from the closest signed quote, then the price book, then a past quote. The note says it is a default suggestion, not a scaled estimate. Comparables list every matching line (signed, sent, draft, declined, including imported history) with size, unit rate, total, customer, discounts and notes. Every line stays a draft until the worker approves, changes or rejects it (quotes.decideDraftLine). Optional scope_of_work (notes is the same field) is the written scope of work. It stays on the draft and quotes.finishDraft copies it onto the quote so the customer page and PDF show it. Do not put private worker notes in it. Nothing is sent. Read the returned lessons first and follow them.

basis.description: Why this price, in a sentence the owner will hear. Required in spirit whenever you set a price.

quantity.description: How many. With unit, this is the measurement (600 with sq ft is 600 sq ft). Default 1.

total_minor.description: Your price for the whole line, in cents. Used when unit_price_minor is left out: unit price is total divided by quantity, rounded to the cent.

unit.description: Measurement you took: sq ft, lf, each, hour, or a count such as window. Stored in the description you write. Comparables still parse size from the description.

unit_price_minor.description: Your price per quantity, in cents. Leave out, with total_minor, for a default suggestion.

notes.description: Written scope of work for the customer quote page and PDF. notes is the same field. Null clears it. Do not include private worker notes.

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
